parsed.note_claim: On 9/7/26, King Charles III thru his Lord Chamberlain released an Official statement that Meghan Markle is not a working royal, is a private citizen, and her charity work is personal.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The charitable work of the Duke and Duchess is a personal matter for them both and undertaken in their private capacity. In short, their position is akin to private citizens with commercial and charitable interests.
parsed.reason: The article confirms the Lord Chamberlain issued a letter at the King's direction on Sept. 7 stating the couple are private citizens and their charitable work is personal.
